nodes.npc: Welcome to the team! I'm Jordan, your team lead. Could you tell us a little about yourself?
nodes.npcZh: 歡迎加入！我是你的組長 Jordan。可以簡單自我介紹嗎？

replies.en: Hi, I'm Taylor. I'll be supporting the sales team, and I'm looking forward to working with everyone.
replies.zh: 大家好，我是 Taylor，會協助業務團隊，很期待和大家合作。

nodes.npc: It's great to have you here. Would you prefer to start with the project overview or the office tour?
nodes.npcZh: 很高興你加入。你想先了解專案，還是先參觀辦公室？

replies.en: The project overview would help me get up to speed.
replies.zh: 我想先了解專案，方便盡快進入狀況。

replies.en: An office tour would be great. I'd like to know where everything is.
replies.zh: 先參觀辦公室很棒，我想知道各個空間在哪裡。

nodes.npc: We're preparing a proposal for a new client. You'll help organize the customer feedback.
nodes.npcZh: 我們正準備新客戶的提案，你會協助整理客戶回饋。

replies.en: That sounds good. When is the next team meeting?
replies.zh: 聽起來不錯，下次團隊會議是什麼時候？

nodes.npc: Let's start with the shared workspace. The meeting rooms are just down the hall.
nodes.npcZh: 先從共用工作區開始，會議室就在走廊另一頭。

replies.en: Thanks for showing me around. When is the next team meeting?
replies.zh: 謝謝你帶我參觀，下次團隊會議是什麼時候？

nodes.npc: It's at ten thirty in Meeting Room B. The calendar invitation should already be in your inbox.
nodes.npcZh: 十點半在 B 會議室，行事曆邀請應該已經寄到你的信箱。

replies.en: I'll check my inbox. Is there anything I should prepare beforehand?
replies.zh: 我會查看信箱，會前有什麼需要準備的嗎？

nodes.npc: Please read the project summary and note any questions. We don't expect you to know everything on day one.
nodes.npcZh: 請先讀專案摘要，記下問題。我們不會期待你第一天就了解所有事情。

replies.en: Understood. I'll review the summary and bring my questions to the meeting.
replies.zh: 了解，我會先讀摘要，並在會議上提出問題。

nodes.npc: Perfect. Let me know if you have any trouble accessing the shared folder.
nodes.npcZh: 很好，共用資料夾如果有存取問題，隨時告訴我。

replies.en: Will do. Thanks for helping me settle in.
replies.zh: 好的，謝謝你幫我適應新環境。
